text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by @ashley -> model-service v2.3.1 at 5% in eu-west-1. Change window: 30m. Release notes: https://go/release/2025-03-16. Watch latency/errors for 10m and report. ID: canary-1758141592
ashley: Kicking off watch. I'll monitor dashboards and traces. if anything >1% 5xx or abnormal tokenization error we pause.
mike: FYI seeing a small uptick on embed-worker in eu-west: 0.4% -> 1.1% 5xx over last 3m. Not huge but trend looks upward.
sara: digging into traces now, tail shows repeated `tokenize()` failures from a particular shard. snippet: ```ERROR tokenize: unexpected char '\ufffd' at position 1024
stack: tokenizer.py:48 -> preproc.py:12```
eng-release-lead: Thanks. Can we correlate to traffic slice? Is this only the canary cohort or also existing traffic?
mike: Looks isolated to the canary slice (same client IP ranges). Legacy traffic still at baseline ~0.2% 5xx.
ashley: Given trend and tokenizer error I propose we pause progression and pin eu-west routing back to v2.3.0 while we triage. That would keep global traffic unaffected. Thoughts?
eng-release-lead: Quick vote: hold and rollback-eu or proceed? Call it now pls.
oncall-sre: from ops POV, hold. If we keep going we risk user impact. I'll standby to open incident if errors cross 1.5% for 5m.
mike: +1 hold. Suggest we also capture a heap + logs snapshot from the canary nodes before draining.
sara: I'll attach the full trace bundle to the ticket. Also found a malformed unicode edgecase in the tokenizer rule set — likely triggered by newly added normalization in v2.3.1.
ashley: OK applying routing pin for eu-west -> v2.3.0 (partial rollback). Deploy-bot please run the eu-region rollback playbook and drain canary instances gracefully.
deploy-bot: Action queued: `rollback-region --region eu-west-1 --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --reason "tokenize errors in canary" --dry=false`
deploy-bot: Routing pin applied. Traffic shifted off canary in eu-west to v2.3.0 (approx 5% of traffic). Canary instances entering graceful drain (max wait 90s). Rollback ID: rb-1758141592-eu
ashley: Updated release notes to mark paused canary and rollback in eu-west. Link: https://go/release/2025-03-16#notes. Will open follow-up PR to revert the normalization change for investigation.
eng-release-lead: Good. Post-mortem / root cause to be created if we confirm new normalization is root cause. For now, keep global rollout halted.
oncall-sre: I'll add continuous monitors on the affected span and watch error budget. If anything spikes will page SRE and escalate.
mike: grabbing heapdumps now, will attach to the ticket when ready.
sara: attaching trace bundle and sample input that reproduces locally. Repro steps added to ticket RT-3421.
ashley: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after triage results. For now: staged rollout paused, eu-west pinned back, incident not opened (monitoring only). :thumbsup:
eng-release-lead: Acknowledged. If anyone sees further anomalies post-drain, ping here immediately.
